payload.name: Servanta
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research monitored print, web, TV, radio, and transcript coverage in your organization's Servanta archive. Search exact terms or concepts, retrieve full articles, compare coverage, and prepare source-linked summaries. Results are limited to content available to the connected Servanta account.
payload.longDescription: 在您组织的Servanta档案库中研究监控的印刷媒体、网络、电视、广播和文字稿覆盖情况。搜索精确术语或概念，获取完整文章，比较覆盖情况，并生成带来源链接的摘要。结果仅限于已连接的Servanta账户可访问的内容。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search monitored media, Retrieve full articles

payload.name: Classic Audioguide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover published museum exhibitions, browse localized exhibit information, access audio-guide content, and identify an exhibit from a visitor-provided photo. Nearby search can use an approximate city-level location. Photo identification sends the visitor photo and selected catalog information to Google Gemini for matching.
payload.longDescription:
发现已发布的博物馆展览，浏览本地化展览信息，访问音频导览内容，并通过游客提供的照片识别展品。
附近搜索可使用大致的城市级别位置。
照片识别功能会将游客照片和选定的目录信息发送至Google Gemini进行匹配。

payload.name: Great Question
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Great Question puts your whole research workflow inside ChatGPT and Codex. Create research studies, recruit participants, and pull what customers said, without leaving the chat. All backed by verbatim quotes you can trace to the session.

You don't need to know which study holds the answer. Ask "What have customers said about our checkout in the last six months?" and it searches your transcripts, highlights and insights, then comes back with quotes, so everyone on your team makes research-backed decisions with confidence.

It works the other way too. Describe what you want to learn and it sets up the study, an interview, survey or prototype test, with the screener, incentive and participants ready for you to review.

Your existing Great Question permissions apply, so it only sees what you can see.
payload.longDescription:
Great Question将整个研究工作流程整合至ChatGPT和Codex中。创建研究项目、招募参与者并提取客户原话，全程无需离开聊天界面。所有内容均配有可追溯至原始会话的原话引用。

您无需知道哪项研究包含答案。询问「过去六个月客户对我们结账流程有何评价？」系统将搜索您的对话记录、重点内容和洞察，返回相关原话引用，确保团队成员都能自信地做出基于研究的决策。

反向操作同样适用。描述您想了解的内容，系统将自动设置研究方案——包括访谈、问卷调查或原型测试，并准备好筛选问卷、激励措施和参与者供您审核。

您现有的Great Question权限设置将被保留，因此系统仅能访问您有权查看的内容。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search what customers said, Pull top complaints with quotes, Read transcripts and highlights, Create research studies and screeners, Shortlist and invite participants, Set interview availability

payload.name: DSTI School of Engineering
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Apply to DSTI School of Engineering with guided support in ChatGPT. Explore programmes and entry requirements, start or resume an application, review what remains, prepare updates, and submit only after your explicit confirmation. Approved study-abroad agencies can also support applicants they represent. Guidance comes directly from DSTI's application system. Documents, identity checks, payments and restricted personal information remain within the secure DSTI Application Portal.
payload.longDescription: 通过ChatGPT的指导支持申请DSTI工程学院。探索课程及入学要求，启动或继续申请，审查剩余事项，准备更新内容，并在您明确确认后提交。经批准的海外留学机构也可为其所代表的申请人提供支持。所有指导信息均直接来自DSTI申请系统。文件、身份验证、付款及受限个人信息均保留在安全的DSTI申请门户中。

payload.name: Perfume Picks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Perfume Picks looks up about 13,000 fragrances with note pyramids, accords, concentration, community longevity, sillage and compliment scores, and list price. Ask what smells like a designer scent for less and get curated dupes with a match percentage and the price difference. Compare two fragrances side by side, get picks from the notes you like with a budget and an occasion, or ask what to wear tonight. Wear scores are community ratings, and list prices are the brand's MSRP. Perfume Picks is read-only: it doesn't sell anything or see anyone's personal wardrobe.
payload.longDescription: Perfume Picks 可查询约13,000种香水的香调金字塔、调性、浓度、用户评价的持久度、扩散性及好评度，并显示建议零售价。询问哪些香水气味类似设计师香水但价格更亲民，并获取精选的替代品，包含匹配百分比及价格差异。可对比两种香水，根据您喜欢的香调、预算及场合获取推荐，或询问今晚该穿哪款香水。用户评价为社区评分，建议零售价为品牌方的MSRP。Perfume Picks 为只读模式：不销售任何产品，也不查看用户的个人香水收藏。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search fragrances, Find dupes, Compare fragrances, Recommendations

payload.name: Derive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Derive notebook to ChatGPT to search and ask about your handwritten STEM notes. Find relevant excerpts, list recent pages, read recognized page text, and inspect available page previews. Text results respect your access to pages, including shared pages. Page previews require an accessible saved thumbnail. The tools do not edit or delete notebook content. Recognized text can contain errors, and long page results can be truncated.
payload.longDescription:
将您的Derive笔记本连接至ChatGPT，可搜索并查询手写的STEM笔记。
查找相关摘录、列出最近页面、阅读已识别的页面文本，并查看可用的页面预览。
文本结果会尊重您对页面的访问权限，包括共享页面。
页面预览需要可访问的已保存缩略图。
这些工具不会编辑或删除笔记本内容。
已识别文本可能包含错误，且长页面结果可能被截断。

payload.name: Dopamine Club
payload.description: 肽类与认知增强剂研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore research on peptides, nootropics, supplements and other compounds inside ChatGPT. Look up retatrutide, BPC-157, L-Theanine or Bacopa to read Dopamine Club's published research, follow original study links and see what the community reports.

Compare two to four profiles, filter cited studies by source classification, and view available website scores, research grades, report counts, sentiment and reported effects or side effects. Source dates, review verdicts, missing data and disclosed text omissions remain visible.

Designed for general-audience educational research. Results come from a versioned Dopamine Club snapshot, not a live or exhaustive literature search. Community reports are anecdotes; counts represent classified mentions rather than unique people. Website scores do not measure clinical effectiveness, personal safety or the percentage of people helped. Administration guidance, promotional passages and unqualified safety claims are withheld; historical study doses are not recommendations. No diagnosis, treatment advice, dosing guidance, vendor recommendations or purchases.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT内部探索肽类、认知增强剂、补充剂及其他化合物的研究。
可查询Retatrutide、BPC-157、L-茶氨酸或 Bacopa，阅读Dopamine Club发布的研究成果，追踪原始研究链接并查看社区报告。

可对比两到四个资料档案，按来源分类筛选引用研究，并查看可用网站评分、研究评级、报告数量、情感倾向及报告中的效果或副作用。
来源日期、评审结论、缺失数据和披露文本遗漏部分仍会显示。

专为大众受众的教育性研究设计。
结果来自经过版本化的Dopamine Club快照，而非实时或全面的文献检索。
社区报告均为个人经历；数量仅表示分类提及次数而非独立个体。
网站评分不衡量临床有效性、个人安全性或受益人群比例。
不提供管理指南、宣传内容及未经验证的安全声明；历史研究剂量不构成建议。
不提供诊断、治疗建议、剂量指导、供应商推荐或购买行为。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search compound research, Read cited studies, Explore scores and community, Compare compound profiles

payload.name: SongDecoder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SongDecoder helps readers examine song lyrics through textual evidence. It separates what the lyrics state from interpretation, maps the speaker's frame and central conflict, and considers possible psychological mechanisms, alternative readings, and effects on listeners. It does not diagnose people or infer an artist's beliefs from a narrator's words. Music, vocal performance, and historical context are assessed only when that material is provided or otherwise available.
payload.longDescription: SongDecoder帮助读者通过文本证据审视歌曲歌词。它将歌词中明确陈述的内容与解读区分开来，绘制出说话者的视角和核心冲突，并考虑可能的心理机制、替代性解读以及对听众的影响。它不会对个人进行诊断，也不会从叙述者的言辞中推断艺术家的信念。音乐、人声表现和历史背景的评估仅在提供相关材料或可获取的情况下进行。

payload.name: SEND Parents Help
payload.description: 为家长提供的友好SEND帮助
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SEND Parents Help gives parents and carers in England clear, checked guidance on special educational needs and disabilities (SEND) and disability benefits for children and young people.

Ask about EHC needs assessments and EHCPs, SEN support at school, annual reviews, school places and school transport, and SEND Tribunal appeals. Or ask about Disability Living Allowance for children, PIP, Carer's Allowance, Attendance Allowance, Blue Badges, mandatory reconsiderations and benefit appeals.

What you can do:
- Get plain-English explanations of each step, including the deadlines that apply.
- Look up the exact wording of a question on supported benefit and SEND Tribunal forms, such as question 64 on the child DLA form, and get help putting your answer into words.
- Find your council's SEND contacts, local EHCP process and support services.
- Get help understanding a decision letter, report or form you have received.
- Ask questions about a SEND Parents Help article you are reading.

Answers come from the SEND Parents Help knowledge base, written from official guidance and legislation. Figures such as benefit rates and time limits come from a maintained register of facts, each with its source, rather than from memory.

SEND Parents Help is run by SEND Parents Help CIC, a Community Interest Company. The guidance covers England only and is general information, not legal advice. The tools only read our published guidance and need no account.
payload.longDescription:
SEND Parents Help为英格兰的家长和照护者提供关于特殊教育需求和残疾（SEND）以及儿童和青少年残疾福利的清晰核查指导。

可咨询教育健康护理评估和教育健康护理计划（EHCP），学校提供的特殊教育需求（SEN）支持，年度评审，学校名额和校车服务，以及SEND法庭上诉。
或咨询儿童残疾生活津贴、个人护理津贴（PIP）、照护者津贴、出席津贴、蓝色通行证、强制性重新考虑及福利上诉。

您可以：
- 获取每一步骤的通俗易懂解释，包括适用的截止日期。
- 查找支持福利和SEND法庭表格中具体问题的准确表述，例如儿童DLA表格中的第64题，并获得帮助将您的答案转化为文字。
- 查找您所在委员会的SEND联系人、当地EHCP流程和支持服务。
- 获得帮助理解您收到的决定信、报告或表格。
- 对您正在阅读的SEND Parents Help文章提出问题。

答案源自由官方指导和法规编写而成的SEND Parents Help知识库。
诸如福利金额和时限等数据来自维护中的事实登记册，每个数据均有来源标注，而非依赖记忆。

SEND Parents Help由SEND Parents Help CIC（社区利益公司）运营。
该指导仅适用于英格兰，为一般信息，不构成法律建议。
工具仅读取我们发布的指导内容，无需账户。

payload.name: Learn It
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Send a photo of a textbook page or a handwritten word list, attach a document, paste your notes, or just say what you want to practice. You get one short link that opens the quiz in Learn It, where you see every question before you add it.

Learn It is an app for practicing vocabulary and quiz questions on iPhone and iPad, used by more than 300,000 students, most of them in Sweden. Practicing there is different from being asked questions in a chat. For a decade, since 2016, the app has been refined around what you see, hear and feel at every answer: animation, sound and haptic feedback tuned to keep practice short, focused and rewarding. That is particularly helpful for students with learning challenges, who often find it hard to get started and to keep going. You practice with multiple choice, by writing the answers, or with flashcards.

Learn It also keeps track of what you have learned. It keeps a record of every word you practice and uses spaced repetition to show which words are due for review, at growing intervals, so you go back to them before you forget them.

There is no account and nothing to sign in to. On a device without the app, the link shows the quiz on trylearnit.com. Ask for changes at any time and you get a new link.

To make the link, the quiz (its name, questions and answers) is sent to Learn It and stored there under a quiz code, the same way a quiz shared from the app is. Anyone who has the link or the code can open the quiz, so leave personal information out of it. Nothing else from your conversation is sent to Learn It.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Make a quiz to practice in Learn It

payload.name: Accent Oracle by BoldVoice
payload.summaryOriginal: Find out what accent you have
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find out what your English accent sounds like with Accent Oracle by BoldVoice, the accent and pronunciation coaching app, right inside ChatGPT. Read a short paragraph aloud and BoldVoice predicts the accents your recording sounds most like, with probabilities and regions. If the first guess is uncertain, BoldVoice asks for one more paragraph to sharpen it. Ask ChatGPT to explain your result. Predictions describe how the recording sounds, not where you are from. No download, account or login needed. Your recording is sent to BoldVoice for analysis only when you stop recording.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中直接使用BoldVoice推出的Accent Oracle，即可了解你的英语口音特征。朗读一段短文后，BoldVoice会分析你的录音并预测最相似的口音类型及对应概率与地区。若首次预测结果不确定，BoldVoice会要求再提供一段文字以提高准确性。可让ChatGPT解释你的分析结果。预测结果仅描述语音特征，不涉及地理来源信息。无需下载、注册或登录账户，您的录音仅在停止录制时才会发送至BoldVoice进行分析。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Guess which English accents your voice sounds like, Show your top accents with percentages and the closest regions, Keep or share your result as a link

payload.name: Whiteboard Video Maker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn any topic into a narrated whiteboard animation video without leaving ChatGPT. Describe what you want explained, and Whiteboard Video Maker writes the script, draws each scene with a hand-drawn whiteboard animation and adds a natural voiceover. Choose the length, landscape (YouTube) or portrait (Shorts, Reels, TikTok), the narration language and the voice. Videos render in a few minutes; ask whether your video is ready to get the MP4 download link and thumbnail. You can also list your recent videos and check your credit balance. Requires a Whiteboard Video account; videos use the account's credits (1 credit per minute) and ChatGPT asks you to confirm before creating one.
payload.longDescription: 无需离开ChatGPT即可将任何主题转化为带旁白的白板动画视频。描述需要解释的内容，Whiteboard Video Maker会撰写脚本，用手绘白板动画绘制每个场景并添加自然语音旁白。可选择视频时长、画布方向（YouTube横版或Shorts/Reels/TikTok竖版）、旁白语言和配音声音。视频几分钟内即可生成；可询问视频是否准备好以获取MP4下载链接和缩略图。您还可以查看最近制作的视频并检查积分余额。需要Whiteboard Video账户；视频会消耗账户积分（每分钟1积分），ChatGPT会在创建前向您确认。

payload.name: Talkio Practice
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Prepare for travel, a job interview, a work meeting, or everyday conversation with short Talkio role-plays. Your assistant conducts the exercise, offers hints, and gives feedback on your replies. No Talkio account is required. Voice depends on the host. This plugin does not provide acoustic pronunciation scores or save progress to Talkio. An optional informational link explains Talkio and this practice activity. No purchases or subscription upgrades are offered.
payload.longDescription: 通过简短的Talkio角色扮演，为旅行、工作面试、工作会议或日常对话做好准备。您的助手将引导练习，提供提示并针对您的回复给予反馈。无需Talkio账户。语音由主机决定。此插件不提供发音评分或保存练习进度至Talkio。可选的信息链接解释了Talkio及此练习活动。不提供购买或订阅升级选项。

payload.name: MasterPiano
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MasterPiano helps piano learners find music they can actually play. Ask for classical sheet music by title, composer, era, ABRSM grade or level, and the score appears right in the chat with a play button, its MasterPiano level (1 to 100) and its approximate ABRSM grade.

What you can ask:
- Find sheet music: "a grade 3 Baroque piece", "easy Chopin", "Gymnopédie No. 1".
- Show and play a piece: the opening bars as notation with a real piano sound.
- Suggest fingering: finger numbers for both hands on the opening bars.
- Check a piece's difficulty: level, approximate grade, what makes it hard and easier pieces to learn first.
- Create a sight-reading exercise: a fresh exercise at your level, in the key and time signature you choose.

The library covers public-domain classical piano music (composers who died by 1925, from Bach to Debussy and Joplin). Songs still under copyright are not available. The card shows the opening bars; each card links to the piece's page on masterpiano.com, where you can read the whole score and practise it with live feedback on your piano. No account or sign-in needed. The plugin cannot hear you play.
payload.longDescription:
MasterPiano帮助钢琴学习者找到他们能实际演奏的乐谱。您可以通过标题、作曲家、时期、ABRSM等级或级别查找古典乐谱，乐谱会直接在聊天中显示，并带有播放按钮，同时标注其MasterPiano等级（1至100）和大致的ABRSM等级。

您可以进行以下操作：
- 查找乐谱："3级巴洛克作品"、"简单肖邦"、"Gymnopédie No. 1"。
- 展示并播放乐曲：以实际钢琴音色呈现开头小节的乐谱。
- 推荐指法：标注开头小节左右手的指法编号。
- 检查乐曲难度：显示等级、大致等级、难度说明以及更适合初学的曲目。
- 创建视奏练习：根据您选择的调式和拍号生成适合当前等级的全新练习曲。

该库涵盖公共领域的古典钢琴音乐（作曲家于1925年前去世，涵盖从巴赫到德彪西及乔普林的作品）。
受版权保护的歌曲无法提供。
卡片显示开头小节；每张卡片链接至masterpiano.com上的乐曲页面，您可查看完整乐谱并使用实时反馈功能练习钢琴。
无需账户或登录。
该插件无法监听您的演奏。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find piano sheet music, Show and play a piece, Suggest fingering, Check a piece's difficulty, Create a sight-reading exercise

payload.name: Paperpal
payload.description: 面向发表的科研辅助工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Paperpal for ChatGPT runs checks that catch issues before you submit: Grammar, Plagiarism, Reference Checks, and Journal Fit. Scan your document for grammar issues and get a deep polish, with results linking back to Paperpal for full review and a tracked-changes download. Run a plagiarism check to see where your document stands, backed by a full report. Check your references and citations across 9 categories, including retractions, hallucinations, excessive self-citation, and citation-reference mismatches. Check journal fit to see if your manuscript meets common pre-submission requirements before you send it in. Results link back to Paperpal for deeper review, full reports, and further manuscript enhancements.

Get started with prompts like:
'Paperpal, please check my references and citations.'
'Paperpal, does my manuscript have language errors?'
payload.longDescription:
Paperpal for ChatGPT会在您提交前进行检查，以发现潜在问题：语法错误、抄袭检测、参考文献核查以及期刊匹配度检测。
对文档进行语法扫描并获得深度润色，结果将链接至Paperpal供完整审核并下载修订版文档。
通过抄袭检测查看文档的原创性，并获取完整报告。
在9个类别中核查参考文献和引文，包括撤稿、幻觉引用、过度自我引用以及引文与参考文献不匹配等问题。
通过期刊匹配度检测查看您的稿件是否符合常见投稿前要求。
所有检测结果均链接至Paperpal，支持深入审核、获取完整报告及进一步优化稿件。

可使用以下提示语开始使用：
'Paperpal，请检查我的参考文献和引用。'
'Paperpal，我的稿件有语言错误吗？'

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Grammar, Plagiarism, Reference Checks, Journal Fit

payload.name: Bright
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Understand what AI is making possible. Catch up on meaningful AI progress, check claims against Bright’s documented evidence, understand why developments could matter, and discover practical things you can try. Bright keeps evidence states, limitations, source dates, Bright publication dates, and links to original sources together.
payload.longDescription:
了解人工智能正在实现的可能性。
跟上有意义的AI进展，验证声明是否符合Bright的书面证据，理解这些发展可能产生的影响，并发现可以尝试的实用方法。
Bright会将证据状态、局限性、来源日期、Bright发布日期以及原始来源链接整合在一起。

payload.name: BoldVoice Pronunciation
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Practice English pronunciation with BoldVoice, the accent and pronunciation coaching app, right inside ChatGPT. Read a word, phrase or sentence aloud and BoldVoice scores every word from 0 to 100, highlights the words that need work, and shows how you said each one next to how it should sound. Choose your own sentence or start with one from BoldVoice, take up to three tries, and ask ChatGPT to explain your result and the sounds to work on. No download, account or login needed. Your recording is sent to BoldVoice for analysis only when you stop recording.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT内直接使用BoldVoice这款口音和发音指导应用练习英语发音。朗读一个单词、短语或句子，BoldVoice会为每个单词打0-100分，标出需要改进的词汇，并显示你发音与标准发音的对比。可自行输入句子或使用BoldVoice提供的句子，最多尝试三次，然后让ChatGPT解释你的发音结果和需要改进的发音。无需下载、账户或登录，仅在停止录音时才会将录音发送至BoldVoice进行分析。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Rehearse interview answers and presentation openers, Hear a coach sound example with a specific practice cue, Compare first and latest scored takes of the same text, Practice a targeted drill, then try a new sentence

payload.name: Kanonix
payload.description: 阿尔及利亚法律，来源已核实
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kanonix opens the whole Official Journal of the Algerian Republic since 1962: more than 220,000 texts in Arabic and French - laws, ordinances, decrees and orders. Ask a question and Kanonix finds the text and the article, says whether it was amended or repealed, and links every answer to the text's page and to the Journal issue that published it. It also follows texts announced but not yet published (bills before Parliament). All tools are read-only; no account is needed to read. Answers are legal information, not legal advice.
payload.longDescription:
Kanonix提供自1962年以来的阿尔及利亚共和国官方公报全文，包含220,000多份阿拉伯语和法语文本——法律、法令、政令和命令。
提出问题，Kanonix将查找相关文本和条款，说明该条款是否被修订或废止，并为每个答案提供对应文本页码及发布该文本的期刊期号。
它还会追踪已公布但尚未发布的文本（即提交议会的法案）。
所有工具均为只读模式；阅读内容无需账户。
所有回答均为法律信息，不构成法律建议。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search Algerian laws, decrees and orders since 1962, in Arabic and French, Read an article or a whole text, with a link to its official publication, Show what amended, completed or repealed a text, Follow texts in preparation before they reach the Official Journal

payload.name: Card.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Card.ai helps users create, organize, and study flashcards. Users can manage decks and cards, add images, search their study material, and review personal study difficulty reports.
payload.longDescription:
Card.ai 帮助用户创建、整理和学习记忆卡。
用户可以管理卡组和卡片，添加图片，搜索学习材料，并查看个人学习难度报告。

payload.name: GenizahSearch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research the Cairo Genizah with Dicta Genizah Search. Find manuscripts containing a Hebrew or Judeo-Arabic word or phrase (exact, with common spelling variants, or near spellings), look up a shelfmark such as T-S 12.123 or ENA 1628.38, find parallels to a passage across the corpus, read a manuscript page with its transcription and a citation that credits whoever made the text, and read catalogue records and bibliography. Answers link to each page on genizahsearch.com. No account needed.

payload.name: LexIA Asistente Legal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Responde consultas jurídicas del Ecuador —tributarias, societarias, contables (NIIF), laborales y municipales— contra el corpus normativo de LexIA y la jurisprudencia contencioso-tributaria, y cita siempre la norma, el artículo y la fecha hasta la que llega el texto. No responde de memoria: busca el artículo, lo lee entero y lo transcribe literal, con sus erratas si las tiene. Cuando el corpus no tiene algo, lo dice y señala dónde mirar, en vez de reconstruirlo. Incluye la jurisprudencia de la Corte Nacional —tributaria, laboral, contencioso administrativa, civil, de familia y penal— y de la Corte Constitucional: buscar causas, leer una resolución, ver el expediente de un juicio. Y las consultas vinculantes del SRI con su PDF y su página. Está pensado para un abogado o un contador, que va a contrastar lo que se le diga.
payload.longDescription:
针对LexIA的规范文献和税务争议判例，回答厄瓜多尔的法律咨询——包括税务、公司、会计（国际财务报告准则）、劳动和市政领域——并始终引用法规、条款及文本覆盖的日期。
不依赖记忆回答：会查找具体条款、完整阅读并逐字抄录，包括原文中的错漏。
当资料库中没有相关内容时，会明确说明并指出查阅位置，而非自行推断重建。
涵盖国家法院的判例——税务、劳动、行政诉讼、民事、家庭和刑事领域——以及宪法法院的判决：可查询案件、阅读裁决书、查看诉讼档案。
同时包含厄瓜多尔税务局（SRI）的约束性咨询，附带PDF文件及对应网页。
该工具专为律师或会计师设计，用于验证所提供的法律信息。

payload.name: Hedraios Scripture Context
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Validate Bible references, study surrounding World English Bible text, preserve event order, and separate explicit text from inference and application using the hosted Hedraios Scripture Context service.
payload.longDescription: 验证圣经引用，研读世界英语圣经的周边文本，保持事件顺序，并通过托管的Hedraios经文上下文服务区分明确文本与推论和应用。

payload.name: Scoutpost
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Scoutpost lets journalists and researchers monitor public sources for news from ChatGPT. Create scouts that watch web pages, local news beats, public social profiles, council agendas and minutes, or ship and aircraft movements. Then search, verify and organize the facts they find, each linked to its source. Scouts run on a schedule, can send email notifications and use credits on your connected Scoutpost account, so ChatGPT asks before creating, running, changing or deleting anything. Findings stay unverified leads until you verify them.
payload.longDescription:
Scoutpost允许记者和研究人员监控ChatGPT的公开信息源。
创建监控器以跟踪网页、本地新闻、公共社交资料、委员会议程和会议记录，或船舶和飞机动向。
然后对发现的事实进行搜索、验证和整理，每个信息都可追溯到原始来源。
监控器按计划运行，可发送邮件通知并使用您连接的Scoutpost账户中的积分，因此ChatGPT在创建、运行、修改或删除任何内容前会先询问您。
发现的内容将作为未验证的线索保留，直到您进行验证。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create and test scouts, Search and verify findings, Organize projects and notes

payload.name: Chessigma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Chessigma answers chess questions with its opening guides, an opening catalogue and facts computed from the rules of chess. Ask about the London, the Caro-Kann, the Sicilian and 15 more openings to get the main line, the key variations and the ideas for both sides from Chessigma's opening guides, or name any of 3,700 catalogued lines to get its ECO code and moves. Paste moves to identify an opening and see where a game left theory. Paste a FEN to get the side to move, check or mate status, material and every legal move. Paste a PGN to get a summary (players, result, opening, how the game ended) and a link that opens the game on the chessigma.com analysis board, plus a review link when the PGN comes from a Chess.com live game or a Lichess game. Share a Chess.com live game link or a Lichess game link to get a link to that game's full move-by-move review on chessigma.com. On those pages Stockfish runs in your own browser. Also: the daily puzzle with its solution, and Elo estimates with FIDE, Chess.com or Lichess K-factor defaults (Chess.com and Lichess use Glicko ratings, so their real changes differ). No account needed.

For chess players of any level who want facts about openings, positions and games. Chessigma does not evaluate positions inside ChatGPT, does not play games, and cannot read your Chess.com or Lichess account: share a game link or a PGN instead.
payload.longDescription:
Chessigma通过开局指南、开局目录以及根据国际象棋规则计算的对局事实来解答国际象棋相关问题。询问伦敦开局、卡罗-卡恩防御、西西里防御等15种开局，可获取Chessigma开局指南中的主流变化、关键变例及双方策略；或直接输入3700种已收录开局线路名称，获取对应的埃科代码和走法。粘贴走法可识别开局并查看对局脱离理论的节点。粘贴FEN格式可获取当前行棋方、将死状态、棋子材料及所有合法着法。粘贴PGN格式可获取对局摘要（对局双方、结果、开局方式、对局结束方式）以及在chessigma.com分析板上打开该对局的链接，若PGN来自Chess.com实时对局或Lichess对局，还会提供复盘链接。分享Chess.com实时对局链接或Lichess对局链接，可获得该对局在chessigma.com的完整逐步复盘链接。这些页面中Stockfish引擎会在您的浏览器中运行。此外还包含每日谜题及答案，以及基于FIDE、Chess.com或Lichess K因子默认值的Elo评级（Chess.com和Lichess使用Glicko评级系统，因此实际变化可能有所不同）。无需账户即可使用。

面向所有水平的国际象棋爱好者，提供开局、局面和对局的相关数据。Chessigma不会在ChatGPT内部评估局面，无法游玩对局，也无法读取您的Chess.com或Lichess账户信息：请分享对局链接或PGN文件。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Opening guides, Opening identification, Position facts, Game summaries, Game review links, Daily puzzle, Elo calculator

payload.name: Fiveable for AP Teachers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fiveable for AP Teachers connects your Fiveable teacher workspace to ChatGPT for AP grading, class materials, assignments, and insights.

Grade a stack of AP free responses. Paste student work in chat or import PDF and Word files on Fiveable, including AP Classroom "By Student Page Break" exports. Direct file uploads depend on the ChatGPT surface you use. Fiveable scores supported AP question types using their AP rubrics and point totals. Review the rubric, adjust individual part scores with a reason, and approve responses one at a time or together. AI scores stay labeled as drafts until you approve them.

Make tomorrow's class materials. Find questions from Fiveable's AP question bank with their stimuli, answer keys, and explanations. Ask ChatGPT to arrange them into a warm-up, exit ticket, worksheet, or review game, with a separate answer key and Fiveable attribution.

Build and run assignments. Set up classes, add a roster, and build drafts from Fiveable multiple-choice questions, free responses, study guides, and guided notes. Drafts stay invisible to students. Publishing, changing publication dates, and releasing results each show a preview and wait for your confirmation. Editing scores or feedback after results are released can change what students see.

See where each class needs support. Review class and student results, answer-choice breakdowns, and topics or skills that need more practice. Ask ChatGPT to use those results to draft a reteaching plan, parent note, or conference outline. When a class has no scored work, Fiveable reports that limitation.

With Google connected on Fiveable, list Classroom turn-ins, export grading results to a Google Sheet, and preview sending approved numeric AP scores to Classroom. Classroom documents can be imported on the Fiveable website. Sending scores does not send written feedback or return the work; you return it in Classroom yourself.

Student identifiers in tool results are minimized to short display names and opaque handles. Structured results omit student emails and account IDs. Full response text is returned only when explicitly requested. Work you paste or upload may contain identifying information, so remove unnecessary personal details before sharing it.
payload.longDescription:
Fiveable for AP Teachers将您的Fiveable教师工作区连接到ChatGPT，实现AP评分、课程资料、作业及洞察分析。

批改大量AP自由回答题。
在聊天中粘贴学生作业，或在Fiveable上导入PDF和Word文件，包括AP Classroom「按学生页面分隔」导出文件。
直接上传文件取决于您使用的ChatGPT界面。
Fiveable使用其AP评分标准和分数总值支持AP题目类型。
可查看评分标准，为单个部分评分并注明原因，逐个或批量批准答题。
AI生成的评分会标记为草稿，直到您批准后才会生效。

准备明天的课程资料。
从Fiveable的AP题库中查找包含素材、答案和解析的题目。
请ChatGPT将它们整理为热身练习、离场票、练习册或复习游戏，并生成独立的答案册和Fiveable署名。

创建并执行作业。
设置班级、添加学生名单，并从Fiveable的多项选择题、自由回答题、学习指南和引导笔记中创建草稿。
草稿对学生不可见。
发布、修改发布日期和公布结果时都会显示预览并等待您的确认。
公布结果后修改评分或反馈会影响学生看到的内容。

查看每个班级需要的支持方向。
查看班级和学生结果、选项分析以及需要更多练习的主题或技能。
请ChatGPT根据这些结果起草重教计划、家长通知或会议提纲。
当班级没有评分作业时，Fiveable会报告此限制。

在Fiveable上连接Google后，可列出Classroom提交作业，将评分结果导出到Google表格，并预览将已批准的AP分数发送至Classroom。
Classroom文档可以在Fiveable网站上导入。
发送分数不会附带书面反馈或返还作业；您需在Classroom中自行返还作业。

工具结果中的学生标识符会简化为短显示名称和不透明标识符。
结构化结果会隐藏学生邮箱和账号ID。
仅在明确请求时才会返回完整答题内容。
您粘贴或上传的作业可能包含个人信息，请在分享前删除不必要的敏感信息。

payload.name: カーリル for AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CALIL for AI lets ChatGPT search the catalogs of more than 7,400 public, university, and specialized libraries in Japan.

What you can do:
- Find library systems by library name or region (for example, a city or ward) and get the system IDs used for catalog search.
- Search up to 15 library systems at once by keyword, title, author, publisher, ISBN, or NDC classification, with optional publication-year filters. Results list matching books, which systems hold them, and a link to each library's catalog page.
- Browse the Nippon Decimal Classification (NDC 9th edition), including broader, narrower, and related classes.

Intended users: readers, students, researchers, and librarians looking for books held by libraries in Japan.

Limitations: Catalog data is provided in Japanese. Search results show which libraries hold a book and link to their catalog pages; loan status and reservations are handled on each library's own site. The plugin cannot borrow, reserve, or purchase books, and it does not access library user accounts. A CALIL account connection is required. Searches are subject to rate limits that control the volume of requests within a given time period.
payload.longDescription:
CALIL for AI使ChatGPT能够搜索日本超过7,400家公共图书馆、大学图书馆和专业图书馆的目录。

可执行操作：
- 通过图书馆名称或地区（例如城市或区）查找图书馆系统，并获取用于目录搜索的系统ID。
- 通过关键词、书名、作者、出版社、ISBN或NDC分类同时搜索最多15个图书馆系统，支持按出版年份筛选。
结果列表将显示匹配书籍、各馆藏位置，并提供链接至各图书馆目录页面。
- 浏览日本十进分类法（NDC第九版），包含上位类、下位类及相关类目。

适用对象：需要查找日本图书馆馆藏书籍的读者、学生、研究人员及图书管理员。

使用限制：目录数据以日文呈现。
搜索结果会显示哪些图书馆收藏了该书，并链接到各馆的目录页面；图书的借阅状态和预约需在各图书馆网站上处理。
该插件无法直接借阅、预订或购买图书，且不访问图书馆用户账户。
需要连接CALIL账户。
搜索操作受速率限制，会控制特定时间内的请求量。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search library catalogs across Japan / 日本の図書館蔵書を横断検索, Find library systems by name or region / 名称・地域から図書館を検索, Browse NDC classification / 日本十進分類法を参照

payload.name: Pandectis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Purpose: search the official texts of Luxembourg, French and European law and return the exact citation with a link to the source.

ChatGPT can look up statutes, codes, court decisions, parliamentary questions and soft law, then read the text before citing it. Each result includes its official references: title, date, court, docket number, ECLI and CELEX.

It is for legal professionals who already have a Pandectis account. Answers are informational and are not legal advice. For an amended statute, the up-to-date consolidated version is the one to cite. A very long document may be returned only in part, and the connector says so. Pandectis does not keep the text of the questions, and the connector cannot see internal documents, matters or conversations.
payload.longDescription:
用途：搜索卢森堡、法国和欧盟的官方法律文本，并返回带源链接的精确引用格式。

ChatGPT可查找法规、法典、法院判决、议会质询和软法文件，在引用前会先阅读文本内容。
每个检索结果均包含官方引用信息：标题、日期、法院、案号、ECLI和CELEX编号。

本工具面向已拥有Pandectis账户的法律专业人士。
提供的信息仅作参考，不构成法律建议。
如涉及修订后的法规，应引用最新整合版本。
过长文档可能仅部分返回，连接器会提前说明情况。
Pandectis不保存问题文本，连接器也无法查看内部文档、案件或对话记录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search the law, Read official texts

payload.name: MockPrep
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MockPrep helps you prepare for job interviews inside ChatGPT. Share a target role and job description to get tailored practice questions, each with why it matters and tips for answering. Paste your answer to any interview question to get a score out of 100, ratings for relevance, structure, evidence, clarity and conciseness, specific strengths, and concrete ways to improve. MockPrep does not store your job descriptions, resume details or answers.
payload.longDescription: MockPrep帮助您在ChatGPT内准备求职面试。分享目标职位和职位描述，以获得量身定制的练习问题，每个问题都包含其重要性说明和回答技巧。将您的面试回答粘贴到任何问题中，即可获得满分100分的评分，包括相关性、结构、论据、清晰度和简洁性的评分，以及具体优势和改进的切实可行建议。MockPrep不会存储您的职位描述、简历详情或回答。

payload.name: Sigma Prep Worksheets
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Make a printable math worksheet with an answer key in seconds. Ask for a topic in plain words, like "a factoring trinomials worksheet with 20 problems" or "law of sines practice, hard", and get a PDF to print or hand out, plus a separate copy with the answer key.

Covers about 490 topics across Pre-Algebra, Algebra 1, Geometry, Algebra 2, Precalculus and Calculus, with easy, medium and hard levels. Every request gives a new version of the problems, so each class or each retake gets its own sheet, and a version number brings the same sheet back.

The problems are written by a program and every answer key is checked by a second program that solves each problem again, so the key matches the sheet. Graphs, number lines and geometry figures are drawn to scale.

No account needed. More options, like choosing question types and spacing, are on sigmaprep.io/worksheets.
payload.longDescription:
几秒钟内生成可打印的数学练习题及答案详解。用自然语言描述需求，例如「包含20道题的因式分解多项式练习题」或「正弦定理练习题（难度：困难）」，即可获得可打印的PDF文件及单独的答案详解版。

涵盖预代数、代数1、几何、代数2、微积分预备课程和微积分等课程的约490个主题，提供简单、中等和困难三个难度等级。每次请求生成独立题库版本，确保不同班级或补考学生使用不同试卷，通过版本号可重新获取相同试卷。

题目由程序生成，答案详解经第二套程序重新解题验证，确保答案一致性。图表、数轴和几何图形均按比例绘制。

无需注册账户。更多选项（如题型选择和间距调整）请访问 sigmaprep.io/worksheets。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find a math worksheet topic from a plain description, Make a printable PDF worksheet, Include a separate answer key, Choose easy, medium or hard and the number of problems, Get a new version, or the same version again

payload.name: MasterKi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MasterKi is a spaced-repetition flashcard app for Android and iOS. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask ChatGPT to turn anything you're learning into flashcards: vocabulary from a language lesson, key points from lecture notes, an article, or the conversation you just had.

ChatGPT writes the cards and saves them to your MasterKi inbox. Nothing is added to your decks until you open MasterKi, review the cards, edit or remove any you don't want, and choose a deck. MasterKi then schedules each card so you review it just before you'd forget it.

To connect, sign in with your MasterKi email and password, or type a pairing code from the MasterKi app (Settings → Connect MasterKi to AI apps). MasterKi only receives the cards ChatGPT sends, never your conversation, and ChatGPT can't read or change your existing decks. You can disconnect ChatGPT at any time from the app.

MasterKi syncs with Anki: connect your MasterKi account to Anki in the app (Settings), then cards ChatGPT saves to your MasterKi inbox can go into your Anki decks.
payload.longDescription:
MasterKi是一款适用于Android和iOS的间隔重复闪卡应用。将其连接到ChatGPT，让ChatGPT将你正在学习的任何内容转化为闪卡：语言课程中的词汇、讲座笔记中的重点、文章内容，或是你刚刚进行的对话。

ChatGPT会生成闪卡并保存到你的MasterKi收件箱。在你打开MasterKi、查看闪卡、编辑或删除不需要的内容并选择牌组之前，这些内容不会添加到你的牌组中。MasterKi会为每张闪卡安排复习时间，确保你在即将遗忘时进行复习。

连接方式：使用MasterKi邮箱和密码登录，或在MasterKi应用中输入配对码（设置→将MasterKi连接到AI应用）。MasterKi仅接收ChatGPT发送的闪卡内容，不会获取你的对话记录，且ChatGPT无法读取或修改你现有的牌组。你可随时在应用中断开ChatGPT连接。

MasterKi支持与Anki同步：在应用中连接MasterKi账户到Anki（设置），之后ChatGPT保存到MasterKi收件箱的闪卡即可进入你的Anki牌组。

payload.name: Celpify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Celpify helps you prepare for the CELPIP-General test, the English test accepted for Canadian permanent residence and citizenship.

Practise CELPIP tasks from Celpify Test 1 in an interactive card inside the chat:
- Listening, with the audio and answer timers
- Reading, with the texts and questions
- Writing, with the time limit and a word count
- Speaking, with the prompt, pictures where the task has them, and preparation and speaking timers

When you finish a Listening or Reading task, check your answers in the card. You see your score, which answers are right or wrong, and the correct option for each question. The card shows the answers only after you check.

You can also ask Celpify:
- What CLB level a CELPIP score equals, with IELTS equivalents, Express Entry CRS language points and the minimum CLB for common immigration programs
- How the CELPIP test is structured: parts and tasks, number of questions and time allowed, based on celpip.ca and the official CELPIP study materials
- Which Celpify study guides cover a topic, such as Listening Part 5 or Writing Task 2

No sign-in is needed.

Celpify is an independent practice platform. CELPIP is a registered trademark of Prometric Canada, and Celpify is not affiliated with or endorsed by Prometric Canada.
payload.longDescription:
Celpify帮助您备考CELPIP通用考试，这是加拿大永久居留和入籍申请中被认可的英语考试。

在聊天中的交互式卡片里，通过Celpify测试1练习CELPIP题型：
- 听力，配有音频和答题计时器

payload.name: Opterio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Opterio works the optics math on the ABO and NCLE optician exams, one step at a time. Ask about a prescription or a frame and Opterio runs the calculation, shows every step, points out the trap the exam likes to set, and rounds to the nearest quarter diopter where that matters.

Twelve calculators:

- Transposition: move a prescription between plus- and minus-cylinder form.
- Spherical equivalent: sphere plus half the cylinder, naming both quarter steps when the result lands halfway.
- Vertex distance: compensate a prescription for a change in vertex distance, one meridian at a time, for example from glasses to contact lenses.
- Prentice's rule: induced prism and its base direction when the eye looks away from the optical center, for spheres and sphero-cylinders.
- Lens thickness: edge or center thickness from power, index and diameter, compared across common lens materials.
- Minimum blank size: the smallest lens blank a frame needs, from its effective diameter, eye size, bridge and the patient's PD.
- Base curve: Vogel's estimate of the front curve for a prescription, halving the spherical equivalent first for a minus lens.
- Lens power: the power from the front and back curves, with back vertex power for a thick lens and lens clock readings converted for the material.
- Prism resolver: horizontal and vertical prism combined into one resultant prism in 360-degree notation, or one prism split back into its parts.
- RGP fitting: a GP contact lens power from the K readings, the glasses prescription and the base curve, with the tear lens and any residual astigmatism.
- Near PD: the reading PD from the distance PD and the reading distance, with the three-quarter rule.
- Effective diameter: twice the longest radius from the boxing center, or an estimate from the frame box and how rounded the corners are.

Every answer comes with a card that shows the result and the working. Open it full screen to change any number and watch the answer update, see the diagram, and try an exam-style practice problem. Answers come in English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Tagalog, Vietnamese or Korean, following the language you write in.

Opterio is for study and for checking your own working. It isn't a prescribing tool and doesn't replace a clinician's judgment.

There's no account to create, and the calculators don't save what you enter.
payload.longDescription:
Opterio会逐步解析ABO和NCLE验光师考试中的光学数学问题。

12个计算器：

- 镜片换算：在正柱镜和负柱镜形式之间转换处方。
- 球镜等效：球镜加上柱镜的一半，当结果处于中间值时同时显示两个四分之一步数值。
- 顶点距离：根据顶点距离变化调整处方，逐个子午线计算，例如从眼镜到隐形眼镜的转换。
- 普林基定律：当眼睛偏离光学中心时，计算产生的三棱镜效应及其基底方向，适用于球镜和球柱镜。
- 镜片厚度：根据镜片度数、折射率和直径计算边缘或中心厚度，并对比常见镜片材料的数值。
- 最小镜片尺寸：根据镜框有效直径、瞳距、镜框宽度和镜片尺寸计算所需最小镜片 blank（毛坯）。
- 基曲计算：通过沃格尔公式估算处方的前曲率，对负镜片需先将球镜等效值减半。
- 镜片度数：通过前后面曲率计算镜片度数，包含厚镜片的后顶点度数，以及根据材料转换镜片测量仪读数。
- 三棱镜分解：将水平和垂直三棱镜合并为360度表示的合成三棱镜，或把单个三棱镜分解为组成部分。
- RGP配适计算：根据角膜曲率读数、眼镜处方和基曲计算硬性透气性隐形眼镜度数，包含泪液镜和残余散光因素。
- 近用瞳距：根据远用瞳距和阅读距离计算近用瞳距，遵循四分之三法则。
- 有效直径：从镜框中心最长半径的两倍计算，或根据镜框尺寸和镜角圆润度估算。

每个计算结果都会显示结果和计算过程卡片。
全屏打开可修改任意数值，实时查看答案变化，查看示意图并尝试考试风格练习题。

Opterio用于学习和核对个人计算过程。
它不是处方工具，不能替代临床医生的判断。

无需创建账户，计算器也不会保存您输入的内容。

payload.name: Manusights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check any citation, anytime: a reference list in your draft, sources an AI assistant suggested (including ChatGPT in this conversation), a literature review, or the references in a paper you are reviewing. And check your manuscript before the journal does.

Check references: paste references or ask ChatGPT to check the ones in your file or earlier in the conversation. Each reference is looked up in Crossref, the DOI registry and Retraction Watch and comes back with its source and check time: resolves, registered outside Crossref, retracted, expression of concern, correction issued, journal flagged, points to a different record, not found, or could not be checked. Only the references are sent, never your manuscript.

Journal AI policies: ask what a journal allows on AI authorship, disclosure statements, AI-generated images, and reviewers' or editors' use of AI. Answers come from Manusights' dated record of the official policy page, with that page linked; when a record is out of date or the page could not be fully read, it says so and links the page instead. Where Manusights has measured it, you also get the journal's typical time from submission to acceptance.

Manuscript preview: attach a manuscript (PDF, Word, ODT, RTF, TXT, Markdown or LaTeX, up to 50 MB) for a readiness score, a verdict and the main risks a reviewer is likely to raise. You can also read reviews already on your Manusights account.

For researchers, students and reviewers who cite papers. Reference checks and journal AI-policy lookups work without an account. Manuscript previews and your saved reviews need a Manusights account; you can sign in with Google, an emailed link or a password.

Limitations: checks report what the sources hold. They cannot tell whether a reference supports a claim, and "could not be checked" (common for books, theses and conference papers without a DOI) is not a sign of a problem. "Not found" means the sources hold no record, which can also be a typo. Up to 100 references per check. Journal policies cover the journals in Manusights' records. Manusights does not write or rewrite manuscripts.
payload.longDescription:
随时核查任何引用：检查草稿中的参考文献列表、AI助手建议的来源（包括本次对话中的ChatGPT）、文献综述，或您正在审阅的论文中的参考文献。在期刊核查前先检查您的文稿。

核查参考文献：粘贴参考文献或让ChatGPT检查文件中的参考文献或对话之前的参考文献。每条参考文献会通过Crossref（DOI注册机构）和Retraction Watch进行核查，返回来源信息和核查时间：显示是否已解决、注册于Crossref之外、已被撤稿、存在担忧声明、已发布更正、期刊被标记、指向不同记录、未找到或无法核查。仅发送参考文献，不会发送您的文稿。

期刊AI政策查询：询问期刊对AI作者身份、披露声明、AI生成图像以及审稿人或编辑使用AI的政策。答案来自Manusights的官方政策页面存档记录，并附上该页面链接；当记录过期或页面无法完整读取时，会明确说明并直接链接到页面。在Manusights已测量的范围内，您还能获取该期刊从投稿到接受的平均时长。

文稿预览：上传文稿（PDF、Word、ODT、RTF、TXT、Markdown或LaTeX格式，最大50MB）获取准备度评分、结论以及审稿人可能提出的的主要风险。您还可以查看已保存在Manusights账户中的审稿意见。

面向需要引用文献的研究人员、学生和审稿人。参考文献核查和期刊AI政策查询无需账户。文稿预览和已保存的审稿意见需要Manusights账户；可通过Google、邮件链接或密码登录。

payload.longDescription:
在聊天窗口直接制作填字游戏、单词搜索或数独，直接在聊天中游玩，并生成带答案页的可打印文档。

填字游戏制作器：输入你的词汇单词和提示（或仅输入单词，系统会为每个单词生成简短提示），GridSmith会生成标准编号的可互锁填字网格，包含横向和纵向提示列表。它会尝试多种布局，尽可能在紧凑网格中放置更多答案，会去除答案中的重音符号和空格（例如ice cream会变成ICECREAM，显示为3,5），并明确告知无法连接的答案。专为教师制作周词汇练习册、家长和谜题爱好者设计。

单词搜索制作器：简单难度的谜题仅横向和纵向排列单词适合幼儿，中等难度增加对角线方向，困难难度则在所有八个方向（包括反向）隐藏单词。每个单词都会被检查确保仅出现一次，避免填充字母中出现混淆重复，无法隐藏的单词会显示具体原因。

带答案的数独生成器：提供简单、中等或困难难度的9x9数独，每个谜题都经过求解器验证，确保仅有唯一解。简单和中等难度可通过基础排除法解决；每个困难难度谜题（给出24至30个数字）需要运用超越基础排除法的技巧。

在聊天中游玩：在填字游戏中使用检查、揭示单词和全部揭示功能；在单词搜索中拖动选择单词；在数独中输入数字和铅笔笔记。打印功能：所有谜题可下载为带姓名和日期行的可打印PDF练习册，以及单独的答案页，支持Letter或A4纸张。PDF内容始终与屏幕上的谜题一致，相同种子可重复生成相同谜题，方便重新打印完全相同的版本。

限制条件：填字游戏网格采用开放式布局（单词周围有空白空间，非对称报纸网格），填字和单词搜索网格仅使用A-Z字母（会去除重音符号，因此仅含西里尔字母或希腊字母的单词无法放置），PDF标题和提示使用拉丁字母印刷，包含波兰语、捷克语和德语，以及希腊语和西里尔字母，但不支持中文、日文、韩文、阿拉伯语或希伯来语，数独仅限经典9x9格式。

payload.name: QuizOffice
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
QuizOffice is an online platform where teachers create worksheets, quizzes and tests, assign them to their classes and follow the results.

With this plugin your AI assistant becomes your worksheet editor. Tell it what you need - subject, grade, number and type of questions - and it creates a draft worksheet in your own QuizOffice account. It can also edit your existing drafts, add or change questions, attach learning materials (for example a PDF the questions are based on) and use images from them.

Supported question types: single choice, multiple choice, true/false, short text answer, essay (graded by the teacher), sorting, pairing, select from list, fill in the blanks, find the word, and flashcards. Mathematical formulas are supported with LaTeX.

Safety by design: the assistant only ever creates drafts. Nothing is shown to students until you review and publish the worksheet in QuizOffice. You sign in with your QuizOffice account, and the assistant can only see and change your own worksheets, materials and images.
payload.longDescription:
QuizOffice是一个在线平台，教师可以在此创建练习册、测验和试卷，分配给班级并跟踪结果。

通过此插件，你的AI助手将成为你的练习册编辑器。告诉它你的需求——学科、年级、题目数量和类型——它会在你的QuizOffice账户中生成一份练习册初稿。它还可以编辑你现有的草稿，增减题目、附加学习材料（例如题目所基于的PDF文件）并引用其中的图片。

支持的题型：单选题、多选题、判断题、简答、论述题（由教师评分）、排序题、配对题、列表选择题、填空题、找单词和闪卡。数学公式支持LaTeX格式。

设计安全：助手仅创建草稿。在你于QuizOffice审核并发布练习册前，学生不会看到任何内容。你通过QuizOffice账号登录，助手只能查看和修改你的个人练习册、材料和图片。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create draft worksheets from a topic, grade and question types, Add, edit and remove questions in your draft worksheets, Use 11 question types, images and LaTeX formulas, Attach learning materials and reuse images from them, List your worksheets, materials and media library

payload.name: AnyLawyer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Research legislation, case law, regulator decisions, procurement materials, and legal registers from authoritative Polish, Central European, and EU sources. AnyLawyer returns source identifiers, citations, official links, and bounded excerpts when available.

Sources include Polish, Czech, Hungarian, and Slovak legislation; indexed EU regulations and directives with CELEX and EUR-Lex citations; Polish Supreme Court, common-court, administrative-court, Constitutional Tribunal, and procurement-appeal rulings; UOKiK, UODO, and KNF materials; Polish tax and labour-inspector interpretations; procurement notices; and current or full KRS company-register extracts.

All tools are read-only. AnyLawyer does not create, change, file, or delete records in any register. Results are research material, not legal advice. Sign-in with an AnyLawyer account is required.
payload.longDescription:
从权威的波兰、中欧和欧盟来源中检索立法、判例法、监管机构决定、采购资料和法律登记册。AnyLawyer会在可用时返回来源标识符、引用信息、官方链接以及限定摘录。

来源包括波兰、捷克、匈牙利和斯洛伐克的立法；带有CELEX和EUR-Lex引用的索引欧盟法规和指令；波兰最高法院、普通法院、行政法院、宪法法庭以及采购申诉裁决；UOKiK、UODO和KNF资料；波兰税务和劳工检查机构的解释文件；采购公告；以及当前或完整的企业登记册（KRS）摘录。

所有工具均为只读模式。AnyLawyer不会在任何登记册中创建、修改、提交或删除记录。结果仅为研究资料，不构成法律建议。需要使用AnyLawyer账户登录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search legislation and case law, Read EU-law articles, Look up KRS company records

payload.name: AristAI Thinker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AristAI Thinker connects your teaching library to your AI. See how many papers, transcripts and other sources you have; find material on a topic; read cited excerpts; and compare your course goals with the material already in your library. Saved video links are listed separately from imported transcripts.

Sign in with your Thinker account and select a library you own. Every connection is limited to that library. Read-only access is the default. If you allow it, you can ask the AI to save a conversation summary and prepare profile suggestions for your review. Disconnect at any time in Thinker.

Search uses literal matching, so a zero result is a reason to investigate further, not proof that a topic is absent. AI recommendations depend on your teaching goals and the available sources.
payload.longDescription:
AristAI Thinker将您的教学资料库与AI连接。
查看您拥有多少论文、转录稿和其他资料；查找特定主题的材料；阅读引用摘录；并对比您的课程目标与资料库中现有内容。
已保存的视频链接会单独列出，而非与导入的转录稿混在一起。

使用您的Thinker账户登录，并选择您拥有的一个资料库。
每次连接仅限于该资料库。
默认为只读访问权限。
如果允许，您可以要求AI保存对话摘要，并为您的审核准备资料库建议。
随时可在Thinker中断开连接。

搜索采用精确匹配方式，因此零结果意味着需要进一步调查，而非证明该主题不存在。
AI推荐内容取决于您的教学目标和可用资料。

payload.name: DAFi
payload.description: 使用您的DAFi笔记进行学习
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your DAFi account to work with your own courses in ChatGPT. Find a course by asking in the chat, explore its content and key concepts, then request explanations or practice questions based on the available material.

DAFi also provides access to quiz results, learning progress, and academic deadlines recorded in your account.

The integration retrieves data available to your DAFi account. Explanations, practice questions, and study plans generated by ChatGPT remain in the conversation and are not automatically saved to DAFi. A DAFi account is required, and available content depends on your account permissions.
payload.longDescription:
将您的DAFi账户连接至ChatGPT，即可使用专属课程。通过聊天提问查找课程，探索课程内容与核心概念，然后根据已有资料请求解析或练习题。

DAFi还可访问测验结果、学习进度及账户中记录的学业截止日期。

该集成功能可获取您DAFi账户中的数据。ChatGPT生成的解析、练习题和学习计划保留在对话中，不会自动保存至DAFi。需要DAFi账户，且可用内容取决于账户权限。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read DAFi courses and notes, Search and read source documents, Review recorded learning progress and quiz results, Read academic dates and deadlines

payload.name: CL for Desmos & Amplify
payload.description: 自定义活动构建器帮助
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Build custom activities in Amplify Classroom and Desmos Classroom with help from ChatGPT. Describe the activity you want in ordinary words: what you're teaching and how students should work through it. CL for Desmos & Amplify plans the screens and components, writes the Computation Layer (CL) code for each one, and tells you how to test every step in the activity builder.

It draws on a curated, read-only knowledge base of CL patterns, conventions and known pitfalls, and reproduces CL from it exactly. Anything it composes beyond a verified pattern is labeled unverified, with what to check. It works for experienced CL authors (terse and peer-level) and for teachers new to CL (one step at a time).

It can help with multiple choice, numeric and math input with equivalence checking, tables, graphs, choice grids, feedback and hints, randomized practice, rounds and levels, timed phases, and progress tracking across screens.

Limits: it can't see or change your Desmos or Amplify account; you paste the code into the activity builder yourself. Preview and test every activity before students use it.

An independent project by Aaron Veek. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Desmos, Amplify or OpenAI.
payload.longDescription:
通过ChatGPT的帮助，在Amplify Classroom和Desmos Classroom中创建自定义活动。用日常语言描述你想构建的活动：正在教授的内容以及学生应如何参与。CL for Desmos & Amplify会规划屏幕和组件，为每个部分编写计算层（CL）代码，并指导你如何在活动构建器中测试每个步骤。

它基于经过筛选的只读CL模式知识库，包含CL模式、规范和已知陷阱，并能精确复现CL代码。任何超出验证模式的生成内容会被标记为未经验证，并附带检查说明。该工具既适用于有经验的CL作者（简洁且符合同行水平），也适用于初次接触CL的教师（分步指导）。

可支持单选题、数值和数学输入（含等价性检查）、表格、图表、选项网格、反馈提示、随机练习、关卡和阶段、定时环节，以及跨屏幕进度追踪功能。

限制条件：无法查看或修改你的Desmos或Amplify账户；需自行将代码粘贴到活动构建器中。在学生使用前请预览并测试所有活动。

独立项目由Aaron Veek开发。与Desmos、Amplify或OpenAI无关联，未获其认可或赞助。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Plan a custom activity screen by screen, Write Computation Layer (CL) from a curated knowledge base, Explain CL errors and known pitfalls, Show how to test each step in the activity builder

payload.name: Bibelbegleiter

Choose hope, gratitude, courage or rest, or browse all seven readings. These seven readings repeat; this is not a full Bible, official church reading calendar, individual pastoral service or live AI generation. Bible translation text is not reproduced; source links lead to an external reading service. The first public edition contains seven repeating original reflections with AI assistance. Independent theological review is not claimed. No account profile, prayer journal, merchandise, subscription or additional model API is provided.

阅读一篇简短的原创德语基督教反思，包含圣经引用、背景注释、反思问题、实际行动建议和原创祈祷。
选择希望、感恩、勇气或安息，或浏览所有七篇读物。
这七篇读物会循环重复；这不是完整圣经、教会官方读经日历、个人牧养服务或实时AI生成内容。

payload.name: HanyuGuide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sign in with a HanyuGuide account to get quizzed on random words from any HSK 2.0 or HSK 3.0 level, look up Chinese words, convert text to tone-mark pinyin, and inspect character stroke data, with definitions in your language. Each quiz links to HSK flashcard practice on HanyuGuide. The same account lets the assistant read your study context and personal lists. With separate permissions, add words in bulk, move or remove words, and create, rename, reorder, archive, or restore personal lists. These tools cannot change study progress, preferences, or billing.
payload.longDescription: 使用HanyuGuide账户登录后，可随机测试任何HSK 2.0或HSK 3.0级别的词汇，查询中文单词，将文本转换为带声调的拼音，查看汉字笔画数据，并显示您语言的定义。每次测验都会链接到HanyuGuide上的HSK闪卡练习。同一账户可让助手读取您的学习情境和个性化列表。通过独立权限可批量添加单词、移动或删除单词，并创建、重命名、重新排序、归档或恢复个性化列表。这些工具无法修改学习进度、偏好或账单信息。

payload.name: Maximos
payload.description: 东正教咨询与教理问答
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Maximos offers Orthodox Christian spiritual counsel and catechesis grounded in Scripture, the Fathers, councils, liturgy, and the received Orthodox tradition. Explore thoughts, passions, repentance, prayer, virtue, relationships, doctrine, and Church history. Its read-only source tools search a bounded corpus and retrieve passages with citation metadata. The two skills distinguish exact quotations, paraphrases, secondary-source reports, and interpretation. Sources and AI answers can contain errors; verify important claims and consult your priest for personal spiritual questions. Maximos provides patristic pastoral counsel and spiritual healing; it is not clinical psychotherapy, diagnosis, or licensed mental-health treatment.
payload.longDescription: Maximos 提供基于圣经、教父、大公会议、礼仪和传承的东正教传统的精神辅导与教理问答。探索思想、情感、忏悔、祈祷、美德、人际关系、教义和教会历史。其只读源工具可搜索有限语料库并检索带有引用元数据的段落。两种功能可区分精确引用、改写、次级来源报告和解释。来源和AI答案可能包含错误；请验证重要声明，并就个人灵性问题咨询您的神父。Maximos 提供教父式牧灵辅导与灵性疗愈；它不提供临床心理治疗、诊断或持牌心理健康治疗。

payload.name: Urantia Papers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Urantia Papers gives the assistant direct, structured access to the text of the Urantia Papers, a public domain text of 196 papers and a Foreword.

What it does:
- Fetches any paper, section, or paragraph by reference, such as 2:0.1, with the paragraphs around it.
- Searches the whole text by keyword or exact phrase, or by meaning.
- Looks up more than 4,400 named beings, places, and concepts, and finds the paragraphs that name each one.
- Finds the passages of the World English Bible that are nearest in meaning to a paragraph, and the Urantia paragraphs nearest to a Bible verse.
- Returns links to narration audio for a paragraph.

It is for readers, students, and researchers who want quoted passages with exact references, and for developers who build study tools.

Limits: every tool only reads, and nothing is saved for the user. There is no account or sign-in. The text is English only. The Bible cross-references are ranked by similarity of meaning; they are not a curated list. The plugin quotes the text and does not interpret it for the user.

This is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with Urantia Foundation.
payload.longDescription:
Urantia Papers为助手提供对《乌兰尼亚论文》文本的直接结构化访问，这是一份包含196篇论文和序言的公共领域文本。

功能包括：
- 通过引用（如2:0.1）获取任意论文、章节或段落，并包含周围段落

- 提供段落的叙述音频链接

适用于需要精确引用的引用段落的读者、学生和研究人员，以及开发学习工具的开发者。

限制条件：所有工具仅支持阅读，用户数据不会被保存
无需账户或登录
仅支持英文文本
圣经交叉引用按意义相似度排序，不是经过筛选的列表
插件仅引用文本，不会对用户进行解释

这是一个独立的社区项目
与乌兰尼亚基金会无关。

Shared packet links contain answers. In-chat PDF attachments are optional and depend on host support.

在嵌入式工作区预览并自定义K-8年级的可打印数学练习，提供匹配的答案页，适用于家长、教师和导师。
选择年级、主题组合和难度等级后，可获得练习册、答案页和合并的PDF文件，以及可恢复原始练习包的链接。
练习内容通过确定性算法生成，不使用付费AI技术。

payload.name: AGAPES Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AGAPES Studio is an educational and theological research tool for biblical exegesis and scripture study. Connect directly to AGAPES Studio to look up canonical Bible passages across historical translations (such as KJV and RV1909), compare versions side-by-side, analyze original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek lemmas with Strong's Concordance numbers, and consult classic historical commentaries (including Matthew Henry, John Gill, Geneva Bible, and Scofield). All queries execute against curated, self-hosted databases in the European Union under strict zero-retention principles. Designed for students, researchers, pastors, and readers conducting biblical, linguistic, and historical study.
payload.longDescription: AGAPES Studio是用于圣经诠释学和经文研究的教育与神学研究工具。直接连接到AGAPES Studio，跨历史译本（如KJV和RV1909）查询正典圣经经文，进行版本对比，分析原始希伯来语、亚兰语和希腊语词根并关联史特朗经文索引编号，还可查阅经典历史注释（包括马太·亨利、约翰·吉尔、日内瓦圣经和斯科菲尔德注释）。所有查询均在欧盟境内运行的精心整理自托管数据库上执行，遵循严格零留存原则。专为学生、研究人员、牧师及进行圣经、语言学和历史研究的读者设计。

payload.name: USAFacts Spending Explorer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Understanding what your school district actually spends money on usually means digging through PDFs and state portals. USAFacts Spending Explorer puts that information in one place, right inside ChatGPT.

Ask specific questions: how much goes to instruction versus administration, how per-student spending compares to a nearby district, or how funding for a particular program has changed over time. USAFacts Spending Explorer gives clear answers alongside an interactive chart — select any category to see its exact share and click to dig even deeper. On the other side, explore how revenue is generated from a mix of state and local taxes, federal sources, and more. 

Then, ask a follow-up the same way you'd ask a person: “What about last year?” or “How does that compare to Dallas?” You'll still get a sourced answer, paired with USAFacts' way of turning complex government finance data into something easy to follow.

Try:
- "What does Los Angeles Unified spend the most money on?”
- "Is Austin ISD's spending going up or down?”
- "How does Austin ISD compare to Dallas ISD?"

payload.name: Motley NYC
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find the right New York City school, and the neighborhood around it. Motley NYC answers families' questions from Motley's data on all 262 NYC neighborhoods and on public, charter and private K-12 schools across the five boroughs.

What you can ask:
- Which neighborhoods fit what matters to your family, ranked by your priorities (playgrounds near home can count too) or compared side by side
- How each neighborhood score is computed, and lists of neighborhoods and schools picked by a stated rule
- A plain-language fit summary for any neighborhood, with safety and health indicators, playgrounds, libraries, accessible subway stations and kids' activities nearby
- Which elementary school is zoned for an address
- Schools by borough, district, grade level, type, admission method or program focus, or a specific school by name
- How NYC admissions works from 3-K through high school (zoned, screened, audition, SHSAT, lotteries and more) and what each method asks of a family
- How a specific school admits students: its method, programs, seats, and applicant counts where NYC publishes them
- Which applications are coming for each child's grade, and when

What to know:
- New York City only.
- No account or sign-in. Every tool only reads; nothing is saved or changed.
- To find a zoned school or place an address, the address you type is sent to NYC Planning's GeoSearch to locate it.
- At elementary level, in-zone students get a guaranteed seat. Some areas, like all of District 1, have no zoned school.
- We never estimate a family's odds of admission. Seats and applicant counts come from NYC MySchools; the competitiveness band beside them is Motley's own reading, not a DOE rating. Most middle schools, and all charter and private schools, have no published applicant counts.
- Neighborhood scores carry the date they were computed. Admission dates are the city's published dates where it has announced them; otherwise we give the usual window and say so.
- Answers link to each neighborhood's and school's page on motley.nyc.
payload.longDescription:
找到合适的纽约市学校及其周边社区。
Motley NYC利用Motley对全市262个社区以及五个行政区的公立、特许和私立K-12学校的数据，解答家庭提出的问题。

您可以询问：

- 特定学校的学生录取方式：其录取方法、课程设置、招生名额，以及纽约市公布的学生申请数量

payload.name: Converge Bio

payload.name: Sommelier's Window
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sommelier's Window helps you decide when to open a bottle. Ask about a specific wine and vintage and get its estimated drinking window, peak years, and current status (for example Hold, Approaching Peak, or At Peak), shown on a simple timeline.

What you can do
- Search the Sommelier's Window database of analyzed wines by name, producer, and vintage.
- Get the drinking window for one wine: optimal years, peak years, how many years remain or until the window opens, a short condition and tasting summary, food pairing ideas, and decanting guidance.
- See a published critic score when one is available, with its source.
- If a wine is not in the database yet, ask for it to be analyzed. The analysis is added as a public page on sommelierswindow.com. New analyses are limited per day.

Good to know
- Drinking windows are estimates for properly stored bottles. Cellar temperature, humidity, light, closure, and bottle variation all affect how a wine ages, so treat the dates as a guide, not a guarantee.
- The status is calculated from the window years and the current year.
- The plugin provides educational wine information only, about how wines age and when they show best. It does not sell wine, process payments, give medical advice, or encourage drinking.
- No account or sign-in is needed, and the plugin cannot see your cellar or any personal data. The privacy policy explains what is processed, including how the daily limit on new analyses is enforced.
payload.longDescription:

payload.name: RegAI Legal (Taiwan)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RegAI Legal gives ChatGPT grounded access to Taiwan's laws and court decisions, so answers cite the actual statute or ruling.

Search statutes by concept or keyword, fetch an article by number (with the official English translation where one exists), browse a law's structure or read its full text, look up a decision by its citation, search apex-court decisions by concept or fact pattern, list every decision containing an exact phrase with the exact total, and search Grand Chamber (大法庭) rulings that resolve divergent legal interpretations.

District and high court decisions are not included.

All tools are read-only and query only public legal data. Queries and law names are Traditional Chinese; ask in English and ChatGPT translates for you. Sign in with a RegAI account (email code or LINE). Results are for research and are not legal advice.

payload.name: LSAT Unplugged

Ask what's on the test and you get the current format. Logic Games came off the LSAT in August 2024, and prep books written before then still teach it.

If there isn't, you get the closest ones that exist. For practice, it links a free drill by question type or Reading Comprehension passage topic.

I'm Steve Schwartz. I've been coaching the LSAT since 2005, and LSAT Unplugged is me plus a team of coaches.
